title: 1916 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship
text:
{{Short description|none}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox Hurling All-Ireland | year = 1916 | image = | dates = | teams = | connacht = Galway | munster = Tipperary | leinster = Kilkenny | ulster = | matches = | poty = | team = Tipperary | titles = 9th | captain = [[Johnny Leahy]] | manager = | team2 = Kilkenny | captain2 = [[Sim Walton]] | manager2 = | totalgoals = | totalpoints = | topscorer = | previous = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1915|1915]] | next = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1917|1917]] }} The '''All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1916''' was the 30th series of the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], [[Ireland]]'s premier [[hurling]] [[single-elimination tournament|knock-out competition]]. [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] won the championship, beating [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] 5–4 to 3–2 in the [[1916 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|final]].{{cite web|url=http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |title=All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Roll of Honour |publisher=The GAA website |access-date=28 July 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110905085701/http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |archive-date=5 September 2011 }} ==Format== '''All-Ireland Championship''' ''Semi-final:'' (1 match) This was a lone match which saw the winners of the Munster championship play [[Galway GAA|Galway]] who received a bye to this stage. One team was eliminated at this stage while the winning team advanced to the final. ''Final:'' (1 match) The winners of the lone semi-final played the winners of the Leinster championship. The winners were declared All-Ireland champions. ==Results== ===[[Connacht Senior Hurling Championship]]=== {{footballbox | date =3 September 1916
